productTitle: Women's Quilted Winter Boots with Plush Lining and Side Zipper
textDesc: Women's quilted winter boots with a round toe and side zipper. Artificial long-plush shaft lining and an artificial short-plush insole are specified. Khaki, Black and Cream are offered with size labels 35-42. Exact upper composition, outsole and midsole materials are not specified. Send quantities by color and size, destination and packing requirements for a quotation. Measurements, international size conversion, availability and requested dispatch dates are confirmed for your order.
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. supports footwear wholesale inquiries. These company capability images describe general business capabilities. Product-specific supply, samples, customization, packing and dispatch are assessed against your order requirements before quotation.
companyFaqDesc: The shaft lining is artificial long plush and the insole is artificial short plush. Exact upper composition, outsole and midsole materials are not specified. Include your material requirements when requesting a quotation.
Which colors and sizes are offered?
Khaki, Black and Cream with size labels 35-42. Send quantities for each color and size. Foot measurements and international size conversions are confirmed for the order.
These boots have a side zipper and quilted upper panels, as shown in the actual product photos.
Can I request samples or customization?
Send your sample quantity or customization requirements with your color-size mix. Feasibility, charges, packing or logo options and any applicable minimums are confirmed before quotation.
How is availability and dispatch confirmed?
Provide quantities by color and size, destination and requested dispatch date. Per-size availability, packing, payment and dispatch terms are assessed for your order before quotation.
What are the minimum and quantity prices?

The listing minimum is 2 pairs. Indicative prices are USD 11.87 for 2-49 pairs, USD 11.08 for 50-99 pairs and USD 10.29 for 100 or more pairs. Final quotation depends on the color-size mix, packing and agreed order terms; freight and taxes are confirmed separately.
